description: Test suite for category management in the focalboard server application, including creation, updating, deletion, and reordering of categories.

methods.name: TestCreateCategory
methods.description: Tests creation of categories, including validation of input fields.

methods.name: TestUpdateCategory
methods.description: Tests updating categories, including permission checks and validation.

methods.name: TestDeleteCategory
methods.description: Tests deletion of categories, including handling of already deleted or system categories.

methods.name: TestMoveBoardsToDefaultCategory
methods.description: Tests moving user boards to a default category, handling existing default category.

methods.name: TestReorderCategories
methods.description: Tests reordering of user categories, ensuring all categories are included.

methods.name: TestVerifyNewCategoriesMatchExisting
methods.description: Validates that new category lists match existing categories by ID.
